This offer uses a different push provider key. Pairing did not change registration or send credentials to a saved relay. Configure the trusted provider separately, wait for its endpoint, then scan a fresh offer.
Pairing offers need an active provider endpoint. Open UnifiedPush settings, configure the provider there, then scan the offer again and review the destination before approving.
